d.ko: For decades, superpowers and psychic abilities were thought to be mere science fiction, but the discovery of a certain particle called the "Astron" at the end of the 20th century proved to the world that these wondrous phenomena were real. Nowadays, these abilities have been dubbed "astral abilities," with those who can wield them being knows as "Astrals."

d.zh: 《RIDDLE JOKER》是日本美少女游戏品牌Yuzusoft于2018年推出的超能力·恋爱题材作品。本作发售后在美少女游戏大赏中囊括了综合、图像、音乐、剧本、影片、角色等诸多奖项。本作由泽泽砂羽、楠原结衣、西园纯夏与遥空组成豪华阵容为女主角献声。并由人气歌姬桥本美雪与佐咲纱花联袂献唱主题曲。
